05/13.09.2024 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Barhi P.S. Case No. 324/ 2023, registered under Sections 323/ 341/ 342/ 406/ 420/ 467/ 468/ 471/ 120-B of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Ms. Arpita Narayan, learned J.M.F.C., Hazaribag.
It is alleged that the petitioner had taken Rupees 6 lakhs from the informant for getting a job against the land of the petitioner which was acquired by CCL.

Learned lawyer appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that he has paid rupees 3,42,500/-
to one Dilip Kumar Mehta.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail and submitted that money has been returned to one of the witness of the agreement.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Ms. Arpita Narayan, learned J.M.F.C.,
Hazaribag or her successor in connection with Barhi P.S. Case No. 324/ 2023, Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
